info.name: BlogHub API v1
info.description: Run '1. Auth > Login (author)' and 'Login (admin)' first. Tokens are saved to collection variables automatically. Change base_url if the server is not on 127.0.0.1:8000.

exec: if (d && d.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('post_id', d[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('post_slug', d[0].slug); }

request.description: name and email are only needed when no token is sent.
Enable profile_image and pick a file to test uploads.
Careful: this really changes the password and signs out other devices.
